question: Evaluate: (92 + 14) ÷ (2 × 53) - 8 + 16
solution:
**Given:**

(92 + 14) ÷ (2 × 53) - 8 + 16

**Concept:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e7a20e61846c6ccd67207a3bc8b140be1db7470dc5524d0e4aa6bcd15a3ce09.png] 

**Calculation:**

According to the question

⇒ (92 + 14) ÷ (2 × 53) - 8 + 16

⇒ 106 ÷ 106 - 8 + 16

⇒ 1 - 8 + 16

⇒ -7 + 16

⇒ 9

**∴ The required result will be 9.**
